turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got some money for my birthday and I want to spend it on board games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice. Do you want the big expansion for the game you already love, or a completely new game with the same money?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Would you mind not chiming in for a minute? My flatmate needs me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you ready for the drive, it's a long one.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I packed snacks for three hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you going to the book club on Thursday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I want to, but I'm only halfway through the book.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Same. It's so slow in the middle.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Right? Pages and pages about the weather.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we just go and listen? Nobody will mind.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: True, and there's always cake. Let's go.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again, Moshi. Could you carry on?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Your birthday money. Was it going on the expansion or a new game?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but I grew up somewhere it never snowed and now there's ten centimetres outside. I have to drive to work.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, a few basics will make a big difference. First, clear all the snow off the car, including the roof, so it doesn't slide onto your windscreen.
